subject: Fix main window stuck behind other windows after startup
body:
Fix main window stuck behind other windows after startup

FrmMain_Shown called Activate()/BringToFront()/SetForegroundWindow()
to bring the main window to front after the splash screen closes
(commit d4bca6b0). SetForegroundWindow can be denied by Windows, which
left the window's activation bookkeeping inconsistent: Alt-Tab showed
it as active but it could never be brought to the foreground again.

The call was redundant anyway - FrmMain_Load already closes the splash
screen before Shown fires, and WinForms activates the main form
normally on startup.

triage.rationale: Removes redundant window activation code that causes inconsistent WinForms state when blocked by Windows on startup. Highly beneficial UX fix.

votes.concern: Removal may regress startup foreground behavior because our splash is now same-thread WinForms, unlike the proposer’s separate-thread WPF lifecycle.
votes.reason: The diagnosis is unproven here, the lifecycle diverged after the shared code, and no tests or reproduction justify deleting a deliberate focus safeguard.

votes.concern: Removes bring-to-front calls; may worsen windows stuck behind others.
votes.reason: Diff contradicts claimed fix; startup focus is delicate and unverified here.
